replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: As a physicist with a PhD, mathematics has been my constant companion throughout my academic career. I see it as the language of the universe - elegant, precise, and beautiful. While I appreciate its theoretical beauty, I've always preferred applied mathematics in physics contexts. My relationship is one of deep respect and occasional frustration when dealing with particularly abstract concepts that don't have clear physical interpretations.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Anxious? No, not at my age. After 70 years and a PhD in physics, I've seen enough mathematics to know what I can handle. The only time I feel any discomfort is when mathematics becomes too abstract without practical application - that's when my physics background makes me impatient for real-world relevance.

Remember, this is pure algebra - in physics, we'd interpret what these solutions mean physically.
